groups.name: Anchors
groups.description: High-strength anchors for concrete, masonry and steel
groups.long: Our anchor range — wedge anchors, drop-in anchors, pin-type anchors, Rawal bolts and frame-fixing anchors — delivers dependable holding power in concrete, masonry and steel for structural, façade and industrial installations.

products.title: Drop In Anchor
products.short: Our Drop In Anchors provides a robust and reliable anchoring solution for medium to heavy-duty applications in concrete. These anchors are designed for easy installation, featuring an expansion mechanism that securely grips the interior wall of the drilled hole when a setting tool is used. Ideal for suspending threaded rods, securing machinery, or mounting shelves, they are a versatile choice for construction and engineering projects. Crafted from high-quality materials, these anchors ensure strength and durability, withstanding heavy loads and vibrations.
standards: Engineered to provide reliable anchoring in concrete applications.
High-quality construction for durability and load capacity.

products.title: Nylon Frame Fixing Anchors
products.short: Our Nylon Frame Fixing Anchors are engineered for secure and reliable anchoring in a variety of substrates, including concrete, brick, and stone. These anchors are designed to provide excellent hold and stability in both interior and exterior applications. The nylon material ensures resistance to corrosion and weathering, making them ideal for long-term use. Their ease of installation and effectiveness in load distribution make them perfect for fixing door and window frames, squared timbers, metal profiles, and cable trays. These anchors are a go-to solution for professionals and DIY enthusiasts alike for their versatile application and durability.

products.title: Pin Type Anchor Bolt
products.short: Our Pin Type Anchor Bolts are engineered for secure and reliable anchoring in concrete, stone, and masonry structures. These bolts are ideal for a variety of applications, including mounting machinery, structural supports, and heavy equipment anchoring. The unique pin-type design ensures a firm hold and easy installation. Made with high-quality materials, these anchor bolts provide excellent strength and stability, making them suitable for both indoor and outdoor use.
standards: Compliant with industry standards for anchor bolts.
Designed for robust anchoring in concrete and masonry.

products.title: Rawal Bolt
products.short: Our Rawal Bolts are designed for heavy-duty concrete, brick, and stone anchoring. These bolts are perfect for applications that require strong, reliable, and easy-to-install fixings. Whether you’re securing wall plates, electrical installations, or heavy machinery, these bolts offer excellent grip strength and durability. The unique design allows for a tight and secure fit, ensuring stability and long-term performance in various environments.
standards: Engineered to meet high industry standards for anchoring bolts.
Suitable for heavy-duty applications in concrete, brick, and stone.

products.title: Rawal Hook
products.short: Our Rawal Hooks are expertly crafted for robust anchoring in various materials, including concrete, brick, and stone. These hooks are ideal for hanging heavy objects securely and are widely used in construction, industrial settings, and home renovations. The design ensures a firm and reliable grip, making them suitable for suspending machinery, heavy artwork, or equipment. Durable and easy to install, these hooks provide a secure hold, ensuring the safety and stability of your installations.
standards: Complies with industry standards for heavy-duty anchoring hooks.
Ideal for applications in masonry and concrete.

products.title: Wedge Anchor (Through Bolt) With Nut & Washer
products.short: Our Wedge Anchors (Through Bolt) with Nut & Washer are the epitome of strength and reliability for anchoring into concrete. Crafted to offer maximum holding power, these anchors are perfect for heavy-duty applications in both construction and industrial settings. Their robust design ensures secure fastening, making them ideal for attaching machinery, structural supports, and heavy equipment to concrete surfaces. The comprehensive range of sizes accommodates various project requirements. These anchors are easy to install and expand upon insertion, creating a strong bond that resists vibration and heavy loads. groups.name: Lockbolts & Collars
groups.long: Permanent, vibration-proof lockbolt and collar fastening systems for heavy fabrication, railways, heavy vehicles and structures subject to extreme vibration and load.

products.title: Lockbolt & Collar
products.short: UCON’s Lockbolt & Collar system, acclaimed for its innovative approach, redefines bolting technology in sectors like truck fabrication, mining, rail, HVAC, and agriculture. Engineered to counteract common drawbacks of traditional bolt-nut combinations, such as preload loss, thread setting effects, and self-loosening under vibration, this system ensures enhanced joint integrity. The Lockbolt’s unique design, with its larger core diameter and special locking groove, provides superior vibration resistance and increased durability. Its collar, replacing the conventional nut, is permanently swaged onto the pin, creating a maintenance-free connection that withstands rigorous conditions without loosening. Ideal for applications facing high vibrations and stress, the UCON Lockbolt offers fast installation, exceptional shear and tensile strength, and reliable long-term performance, making it an indispensable solution for ensuring safety and efficiency in demanding environments.
